name: PortConMaine
blurb: Maine's geek-culture convention in Portland with anime, gaming, cosplay contests and a vendor/artist hall; grown from 250 attendees in 2002 to about 4,000 today.

editions.evidence: Homepage countdown + text: "Countdown to PortConMaine 2027 ... June 24th, 2027 PortConMaine Opening Day!"

notes: The official site's countdown only confirms the June 24, 2027 opening day; the June 27 end date is inferred from the con's usual four-day Thu-Sun run (corroborated by web search). The Guest Listing page renders no guest cards yet, only boilerplate intro text, so 2027 guests are not yet announced.
